issue.title: Deploy job races the cache warm step
issue.description:
Steps to reproduce:
1. Trigger a deploy while the cache warm step is still running
2. Observe the deploy publish a partially warmed cache

Expected: the deploy job waits for the cache warm step to finish before publishing.

nodes.body: **Automated QA triage completed.** Verdict: reproduced. Triage evidence: cache_warm_wait_gate. Workstream published at /tmp/criteria-intake/CRI-140/workstreams/CRI-140.md. The fix is to add a dependency edge from the deploy job to the cache warm step in the deploy graph.
Reproduction details: deploy run id rr-5173 shows the publish step starting 40s before cache_warm exits. The cache manifest written at that point is missing keys cache:model-v2 and cache:tokenizer.
